migration_flags.description: OBSERVED: the xmlid upsert writes noupdate only on first INSERT and never changes it on conflict; the loader skips writes in update mode using the stored flag, and the converter applies a second, independent container-level gate. Customer-modified views, record rules, mail templates and chart-template records rely on this. PRIOR-VERSION-KNOWLEDGE: the same two-layer design existed earlier; not re-verified here.

OBSERVED: ir.model.data declares no date_init or date_update fields, only ORM create/write dates. PRIOR-VERSION-KNOWLEDGE: earlier releases carried date_init and date_update; the release that dropped them is UNKNOWN - EVIDENCE INSUFFICIENT. Any SQL or export relying on those columns must be re-checked.

OBSERVED: noupdate is accepted only on odoo/data/openerp containers; record elements accept id, forcecreate and model only; forcecreate matters only inside the noupdate-update gate, the foreign-prefix branch and unresolved references.

OBSERVED: end-of-load cleanup deletes records of non-noupdate xmlids that were not reloaded; noupdate xmlids of records no longer shipped survive as orphans; uninstall ignores the flag and removes all xmlid records of the module.

OBSERVED: no xmlid rename helper in odoo/orm, odoo/modules, odoo/tools or base models (only DB column rename and a category-rename comment); __export__ and __import__ pseudo-modules are present. Renamed xmlids therefore need migration scripts (U102).
OBSERVED: load_manifest, get_modules_with_version, convert_file kind argument, init_xml manifest key and Registry.manage_changes are deprecated since 19.0; zero Community manifests use init_xml.

OBSERVED: ir.model.data and ir.module.module declare constraints with models.UniqueIndex, models.Index and models.Constraint. PRIOR-VERSION-KNOWLEDGE: earlier releases used _sql_constraints lists; customisations overriding those lists must be rewritten.

OBSERVED: ir.module.module installed_version is labelled Latest Version and holds the on-disk version, latest_version is labelled Installed Version and holds the database version, per the source comment.

OBSERVED: fields country_ids, has_iap, icon_flag, to_buy, dependency auto_install_required, category privilege_ids; manifest keys countries, external_dependencies, bootstrap, cloc_exclude, kpi_providers present in defaults. PRIOR-VERSION-KNOWLEDGE: not all existed in v16 or v17; which release added each is UNKNOWN - EVIDENCE INSUFFICIENT.
OBSERVED: the web column exists in bootstrap SQL and the manifest defaults but ir.module.module has no ORM field web; no Community manifest sets web.

OBSERVED: fresh-database auto-install SQL does not evaluate the countries key while button_install requires a matching company country; empty-list auto_install would diverge between the two paths (RT; zero Community manifests use it). l10n_th uses auto_install ['account'] with countries ['th'].

OBSERVED: l10n_th declares only a post_init_hook that flips noupdate to true on its account tag xmlids; pre_init_hook, uninstall_hook and post_load are ABSENT; chart templates are written by the account chart-template loader with noupdate true under account.<company_id>_<xmlid> names, not by manifest data.
OBSERVED: load_demo returns True also for modules without demo files, so the demo flag is true whenever demo is installable and loading did not fail; demo files are loaded with noupdate true.

OBSERVED: install and reinit load data in init mode, upgrade in update mode, so noupdate protection applies only on upgrade; an install over an existing module database re-writes records even when flagged noupdate.

key_findings.module_states: uninstallable, uninstalled, installed, to upgrade, to remove, to install (ir_module.py:140-147)
key_findings.module_fields_notes: installed_version and latest_version labels are swapped; license selection has ten values; no ORM web field
key_findings.dependency_state: derived only from linked module state, unknown when module missing (ir_module.py:1039-1042)
key_findings.xmlid_unique_key: unique index on (module, name); index on (model, res_id); no date_init/date_update (ir_model.py:2252-2254)
key_findings.xmlid_lookup: cached _xmlid_lookup raises ValueError when no row or empty res_id; env.ref also tests existence (ir_model.py:2281-2292; environments.py:166-175)
key_findings.create_update_skip_rule: update mode skips write when stored noupdate is true; init mode rewrites; missing target row deleted and recreated (models.py:5167-5182)
key_findings.converter_noupdate: container-level only; record gate only in update mode; forcecreate default true (convert.py:360-379, 605)
key_findings.load_order_per_module: pre-migrate, load package/post_load, pre_init_hook (install), models/schema, data, demo, post-migrate, translations, post_init_hook (install), view validation (upgrade), state installed (loading.py:159-273)
key_findings.end_cleanup: _process_end removes non-noupdate xmlids not reloaded in this run, only when modules were updated (ir_model.py:2657-2660; loading.py:513, 523)
key_findings.uninstall_order: data, copied views, constraints, selections, fields, relations, models, xmlid rows (ir_model.py:2582-2635)
key_findings.hooks: post_load fn() once per process; pre_init_hook/post_init_hook/uninstall_hook fn(env); prevalence 0/6/94/62 of 692 manifests (scripted scan)
key_findings.l10n_th: depends account_qr_code_emv and account; auto_install ['account']; countries ['th']; post_init_hook _preserve_tag_on_taxes only (l10n_th/__manifest__.py:3-29)
key_findings.chart_template: records written with noupdate True via _load_records, names account.<company_id>_<xmlid> (chart_template.py:688-698, 1226-1230)
key_findings.registry_reload: immediate runner, upgrade wizard, force_demo, uninstall recursion, signaling mismatch (ir_module.py:638; loading.py:553-555; registry.py:1112-1115)
key_findings.xmlid_rename_helper: ABSENT within grep scope; __export__ and __import__ present
